items.title: Ernest McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: Well on records, during that time, Charlotte Christian for Swing and Les Paul for Technique.

ctx.x: tell us in the country that you, even on records, who were your favorite guitar players?
Well on records, during that time, Charlotte Christian for Swing and Les Paul for Technique. Yeah. I mean, that was my two favorite guitar players.
Did you ever hear of Charlie Christian in person or just on the record?
